## Review is a separate control

A successful build is not approval. Review the exact private candidate and its
automated QA before an authorised approver records a decision.

## Common checks

Confirm that:

- the product, period, version, source releases and method are the intended ones;
- logs and receipts report success and required files exist;
- counts, proportions, rates, trends and denominators are plausible;
- missingness, exclusions, warnings and changes from the prior release are understood;
- labels, scope, notes and interpretations match the data;
- the **n < 6** disclosure rule and any necessary complementary protection have
  been applied across the complete release;
- no combination of datasets, tables, charts, text or downloads reveals a
  protected value; and
- no confidential record, private path, credential, log or review file is in
  the proposed public payload.

Use the workflow-specific workbook, manifest, QA summary and comparison outputs;
the exact files differ between event, mortality, annual and one-off candidates.

## Outcomes

- **Ready:** retain the review evidence and proceed to the workflow's separate
  approval action.
- **Not ready:** stop, correct the authoritative data, code or configuration,
  and rebuild from the earliest affected step.

Never change a generated candidate to make it pass review. A changed payload is
a new candidate and requires renewed review.

See [Disclosure control](disclosure-control.qmd) and
[Approve and publish](approve-publish.qmd).
